description.narrative: The grant will support the initiatives of the Government in ensuring good governance, as reflected in more transparent, predictable, and accountable central and local government administration, as well as better frontline service delivery and less corruption in the public sector, through active public participation.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President

description.narrative: (i) Citizens and communities actively engaged with local bodies and hold them accountable (ii) Better management of resources and delivery of services in an inclusive and equitable manner by capable local bodies (iii) Strengthened policy and national institutional framework for decentralization and community development

i.a: Yearly increase in number of disadvantaged groups utilizing program resources Progress/Status: Partly achieved. Data Source: • MLD reports • Baseline and final survey reports • Midlevel agency and NGO reports • Joint annual review report • Program evaluation reports • Parliamentary reports • Independent assessments by development partners Base year: 2010 Baseline value: N

iii.a: Relevant legal provisions for devolution are adequately provided Progress/Status: The Constituent Assembly has not yet fully completed deliberations on these provisions. Data Source: • MLD reports • Baseline and final survey reports • Midlevel agency and NGO reports • Joint annual review report • Program evaluation reports • Parliamentary reports • Independent assessments by development partners Base year: 2010 Baseline value: N

iii.b: Perceived capacity gaps at MLD to support local governance are lower Progress/Status: The gaps have already been identified and remedial measures have been included in the relevant ASIPs. Data Source: • MLD reports • Baseline and final survey reports • Midlevel agency and NGO reports • Joint annual review report • Program evaluation reports • Parliamentary reports • Independent assessments by development partners Base year: 2010 Baseline value: N

iii.c: Local body associations are more able to advocate for local bodies, as compared with 2007-2008 Progress/Status: Almost 35% of the surveyed VDC Secretaries felt that NAVIN was performing “better now than a year before. Data Source: • MLD reports • Baseline and final survey reports • Midlevel agency and NGO reports • Joint annual review report • Program evaluation reports • Parliamentary reports • Independent assessments by development partners Base year: 2010 Baseline value: N

Data Source: • MLD reports • Baseline and final survey reports • Midlevel agency and NGO reports • Joint annual review report • Program evaluation reports • Parliamentary reports • Independent assessments by development partners Base year: 2010 Baseline value: N
